Subject: Discovery recap + MAP draft attached

Hi Anna —

Thanks again for the call this morning. As promised, attached is the first draft of the Mutual Action Plan (Novafin_MAP_v1.0.xlsx). Below is a short recap and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum.

Key objectives
- Quick summary: pilot Redwood inference (hosted) on customer-facing search reranking for credit products.
- Target KPIs: 20% reduction in average query latency, 15% improvement in NDCG at top-5 by end of pilot.

Proposed MAP highlights (draft):
- Milestone 1 (Discovery close): finalize scope & contact list — target: 2027-02-05 — Owner: Novafin (Anna) / Redwood (Marissa)
- Milestone 2 (Pilot onboarding): test data handoff + model selection — target: 2027-02-18 — Owner: Novafin (Data eng) / Redwood (Rishi)
- Milestone 3 (Pilot run & eval): 2-week pilot, success criteria review — target: 2027-03-04 — Owner: Novafin (PM) / Redwood (Marissa)
- Milestone 4 (Procurement & SOW): finalize agreement & PO — target: 2027-03-15 (target close) — Owner: Novafin Procurement / Redwood Sales

Dependencies called out in the MAP: security questionnaire completion (SOC 2 evidence), sample data share (PII-filtered), procurement PO issuance.

Ask: please review v1.0 and confirm (a) owners above, (b) the target close date, and (c) any missing dependencies we should add. If ok, I’ll schedule a 30-min weekly checkpoint starting next Monday to track open items.

Attachments: Novafin_MAP_v1.0.xlsx (MAP draft)

Thanks —
Marissa
